name: § 1 - Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the illegal Türkiye-Libya Memorandum of Understanding and infringement of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
part_text: 1. Strongly condemns the MoU as unlawful and incompatible with international law and the applicable principles of the law of the sea, and as an attempt to create unilateral and maximalist claims that undermine the sovereign rights of Member States; reaffirms that the MoU infringes the sovereign rights of third states, does not comply with the law of the sea, is null and void in its entirety and from the outset, and cannot produce any legal consequences for third states, nor establish any legal or institutional precedent; rejects any attempt to invoke, implement or rely on the MoU as a legal basis for maritime claims affecting the sovereign rights or maritime entitlements of Greece or any other third state;
